summary.text: Steve Meredith is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 5, serving since 2017. The legislature's profile lists Meredith as chair of the Senate Health Services Committee. The profile name is Stephen Meredith.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Stephen Meredith was born on June 21, 1953, and is a retired hospital CEO.
The profile lists a B.S. from Western Kentucky University and a master's in health administration from the University of Minnesota.
It also lists a term as past chair of the Kentucky Hospital Association and membership in the Grayson County Rotary Club and the Knights of Columbus.
